Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Chesteen
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 03/25/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 321 as introduced could increase business license fee collections to municipalities by an undetermined amount dependent on the additional amount of business license fees collected by a municipality from businesses located in other jurisdictions that provide lease or rental services in the municipality.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs
